stateAndPrivacy.adminDirectoryRawSearch: auth-scoped session-local state only; never URL/history/storage
stateAndPrivacy.queryOnlyAdminListDetailTransition: shared root and scroll owner; no remount race
stateAndPrivacy.invitationBearer: copy-only/in-memory; never DOM URL history hash or storage
stateAndPrivacy.publicProfileBlockReceipt: only JSON object success:true flips local blocked state; failures retain state with fixed safe receipt
stateAndPrivacy.workspaceAccountDeletion: body-teleported V2 portal; typed name plus acknowledgement; exact expected_action=delete-account; only same-relation deleted receipt navigates; failures retain route/relation with fixed safe message
stateAndPrivacy.workspaceSessionTermination: existing body-teleported confirmation; cancel/Escape does not DELETE; only exact terminated_session_id changes local sessions; 400/403/404/malformed/network retain route/relation/displayed session with fixed safe copy
stateAndPrivacy.workspaceRelationMutation: existing body-teleported confirmation; cancel/Escape does not DELETE; only same-relation revoked/deleted receipts reconcile; 400/403/404/wrong-id/wrong-status/malformed/network retain dialog, relation, route and query with fixed safe copy
stateAndPrivacy.commodityMutation: admin-only /admin/commodities keeps form, confirmation and receipt state local; create/update require exact status plus target identity/parent receipt, commodity/alias deletion requires 204 with an empty receipt, and mismatch/error/stale detail retains context with fixed safe feedback
stateAndPrivacy.adminUserDeletion: admin-only /admin/users/:id keeps confirmation and receipt state local; delete requires HTTP 200 plus the exact message receipt then navigate manage_users; terminate-all requires HTTP 200 plus integer terminated_sessions >= 0 without displaying raw detail; cancel/Escape send no request; 400/403/404/malformed/network retain context with fixed safe copy and no account_name/mobile in the dialog
stateAndPrivacy.accountSecuritySessions: existing /account/security keeps confirmation and receipt state local; terminate one other session requires HTTP 200 plus the exact Persian success detail then removes only that session; logout-others requires HTTP 200 plus a digit-prefixed ended-sessions detail without displaying raw detail; cancel/Escape send no request; 400/403/404/malformed/network retain the dialog and session list with fixed safe copy and no device name in the dialog
stateAndPrivacy.accountStorageLocalClear: existing /account/storage keeps confirmation and local receipt state on-device; cancel/Escape perform no clear or reload; success sets displayed size to 0.00 MB and records one local reload; local failure retains the dialog and displayed size with fixed safe copy and no cache-store internals in the dialog
stateAndPrivacy.adminAccountStatus: admin-only /admin/users/:id keeps account-status, unblock and remove-limitations confirmation local; deactivate requires HTTP 200 plus inactive status with a valid grace timestamp and null web-lock; cancel/Escape send no request; 403/404/malformed/network retain the dialog and displayed user with fixed safe copy, Escape hint, and no account_name/mobile in the confirmation
stateAndPrivacy.adminUserChrome: existing /admin/users/:id keeps mutation receipts; settings actions use shared ui-action-card chrome and block/limitations remain form dialogs with ui-input/ui-button; no account_name/mobile is added to overlays

phase4.contract: pending invitation bearer is copy-only/in-memory; revoke is body-teleported confirmation; 204 receipt removes, 400/404 reconcile, and 403 clears sensitive state

phase5.contract: block/unblock reuses canonical ID-only public-profile route; dialog/receipt stay local; only success:true flips state and failure copy is fixed/safe

phase6.contract: body-teleported V2 account-deletion portal requires typed confirmation plus acknowledgement; expected_action is delete-account; only same-relation deleted receipt navigates

phase7.contract: reuses the existing workspace confirmation dialog for one session; only exact terminated_session_id applies local removal/promotion, while any failure retains dialog, route, relation and displayed session with fixed safe copy

phase8.contract: reuses existing workspace confirmation for customer cancel-invitation/close-relation and accountant cancel-invitation/delete-relation; only same-relation revoked/deleted receipts reconcile, while failures retain dialog, relation, route and query with fixed safe copy

phase9.contract: commodity create/update accepts only exact status and identity/parent receipts; commodity or alias deletion uses body-teleported confirmation and applies local removal only for a 204 empty receipt, while mismatch/error/stale detail retains local context with fixed safe feedback

phase10.contract: admin user deletion and terminate-all reuse the existing /admin/users/:id route; delete applies navigation only after HTTP 200 plus the exact success message receipt, terminate-all accepts only HTTP 200 plus integer terminated_sessions >= 0, cancel/Escape send no request, and 400/403/404/malformed/network retain the dialog and displayed user with fixed safe copy and no account_name/mobile in the confirmation

phase11.contract: account-security session mutations reuse the existing /account/security route; terminate applies local removal only after HTTP 200 plus the exact success detail, logout-others accepts only HTTP 200 plus a digit-prefixed ended-sessions detail, cancel/Escape send no request, and 400/403/404/malformed/network retain the dialog and session list with fixed safe copy and no device name in the confirmation

phase12.contract: account-storage local cache clear reuses the existing /account/storage route; confirmation is body-teleported; cancel/Escape perform no clear or reload; success applies the local clear then one reload receipt; local failure retains dialog and displayed size with fixed safe copy and no cache internals

phase13.contract: admin account-status, unblock and remove-limitations reuse the existing /admin/users/:id route; deactivate applies only after HTTP 200 plus inactive status with a valid grace timestamp and null web-lock; cancel/Escape send no request; 403/404/malformed/network retain the dialog and displayed user with fixed safe copy, an Escape hint, and no account_name/mobile in the confirmation

phase14.contract: admin user settings menu and block/limitations forms reuse the existing /admin/users/:id route; action rows use shared ui-action-card chrome, form dialogs stay AppResponsiveDialog with ui-input/ui-button, mutation/Escape receipts from phases 10 and 13 are unchanged, and no account_name/mobile is added to overlays

claimBoundary: This manifest describes the delivered route/state boundary only. It does not authorize deferred Stage 6 work, prove a live backend, publish Sites, or change staging/production.
